summary: Bowman Consulting Group disclosed in an 8-K that its go-shop period under the August 10, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with Prive Parent, Inc. and Prive Merger Sub, Inc. — affiliates of Bernhard Capital Partners — expired September 14, 2026. The merger, a US take-private, requires a special meeting stockholder vote and an SEC-reviewed Schedule 14A proxy. No price, premium, or close date is stated in this excerpt. Watch for a topping bid after the go-shop lapse, proxy filing timing, and any dissent or financing risk affecting deal certainty.
